memory_candidates.insight: Generate #guard_msgs/#print axioms pin blocks from a compiled scratch probe rather than hand-predicting them. The expected message includes the formatter's own line wrapping, which #guard_msgs compares verbatim; a probe file of bare '#print axioms Name' lines run through 'lake env lean' yields the exact text to transcribe. 42 pins landed green on the first build this way.

A records-and-verification phase should re-read the module docstrings its earlier phases wrote, not just append the new verdict. A 'What this module does not hold' section authored before the later phases landed will still deny what those phases built, leaving a false claim beside a true verdict in the same docstring.

When a final-phase instruction says a gate's pre-existing out-of-scope failures count as a recorded PASS, still attribute every finding individually. A gate can be failing on BOTH a concurrent sibling's file (attribute, do not edit) and this task's own file (repair) at the same time, and the carve-out reaches only the former.
